label: HIPAA Breach Notification Rule
authority: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS OCR)

triggers.label: Breach discovered
triggers.hint: The first day the breach is known, or would have been known with reasonable diligence.

clocks.label: Notice to individuals
clocks.rule: Without unreasonable delay and no later than 60 calendar days after discovery.

clocks.label: Notice to HHS
clocks.rule: Within 60 days when 500 or more people are affected; for fewer, within 60 days after the end of the calendar year (this clock shows the 500-or-more case).

clocks.label: Notice to media
clocks.rule: Within 60 days when more than 500 residents of a state or jurisdiction are affected.

appliesTo.note: Covered entities and business associates holding protected health information.
